title: Octave's Android TV app is the server's e2e gate
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need."; Goal 1: "Playback never surprises a viewer.". D-134.
acceptanceCriteria: Octave's Android TV test build, on an emulator against the change's server, is the e2e gate: sign-in, Films and Shows, play, seek, resume, a track switch, a refusal's reason, and a killed worker.
The server pins that build by digest, and a separate change moves the pin, so an app regression blocks only the pin's move, never a server change.
It runs on every merge and is never skipped.
The dogfood moves from `jellyfin-final` to main once Octave's Android TV app browses and plays there (D-116 as amended by D-134).
notes: Cross-project need (D-132): starts when Octave publishes an Android TV test build per commit (ASK-4). Until then the native browser check and the Media3 harness are the gate.
